config.notes: P2 RAW motion training. The shipped noise-config geometry (64x64 sensor -> 32x32 packed for CFA) is below the vendored 4-level correlation pyramid minimum of 128 packed cells per side at iters>0, so this config declares a 256x256 sensor override and scales every pixel-valued scene length by 4 to preserve the declared relative motion, occlusion size and texture scale; translation_subpixel sequence tokens are absolute declarations and are not scaled. The two LR tiers and the iteration tiers come from the pinned author recipe (config/train/Tartan-C368x496-M.json: lr 2.5e-4, iters 4); the formal budget is the authorised first segment of 100k updates with the author 100k-300k range as the ceiling.

condition_descriptions.real_improvement_over_run: first_value - best_value must be strictly greater than delta_val
condition_descriptions.two_effective_lr_drops: at least two effective LR drops must have been applied
condition_descriptions.final_low_lr_phase: the run must be in the final low-LR phase
condition_descriptions.flat_tail_below_delta_val: the last plateau_checks improvements must each be below delta_val
condition_descriptions.best_not_at_budget_end: the best checkpoint must not sit inside the last plateau_checks validation windows of the budget
condition_descriptions.diagnostics_passed: the small-set fit / input / gradient diagnostics must pass
